app.tagline: A situated Cantonese copilot for Hong Kong. It knows where you are, speaks up at the right moment, and teaches you the phrase so next time you won't need it.
app.languageHint: Changes the app and the language we translate back into.
home.minibusSub: Know when to shout 有落 — or let the app shout for you
home.taxiSub: Show the address in Chinese, estimate the fare, watch the route
home.clinicSub: Say what's wrong, and see where the A&E wait is shortest
home.chachaantengSub: Point at a menu, order like a local
home.whyBody: Translators answer when you ask. Yau Lok knows when to speak — it tracks the route, alerts you before your stop, and shouts in colloquial Cantonese so the driver actually stops.
home.credits: Cantonese speech & translation by HKGAI Modelhub · routes and live arrivals via HKGAI Toolhub & HK open government data
ride.whereTo: Where do you want to go?
ride.whereToHint: Name the place — we'll find the minibus, the fare and the stop.
ride.knowCode: I already know the route code
ride.noMinibus: No green minibus on this trip — showing buses instead. Yau Lok still tracks them and shouts for you.
ride.etaLive: live from HKGAI Toolhub · updates every 30s
ride.noArrivals: No live arrivals at this stop right now.
ride.fareHint: Minibus drivers rarely give change — have coins or Octopus ready.
ride.comingUp: Your stop is coming up — get ready!
ride.shoutNow: SHOUT NOW — your stop is here!
ride.arrived: You made it — 唔該晒 driver!
ride.umbrella: Bring an umbrella — you'll be waiting at the kerb.
say.hint: Speak or type in your own language — HKGAI turns it into what a local would actually say, then says it out loud for you.
taxi.hint: We'll show the driver the address in Chinese, estimate the fare, and watch the route while you ride.
taxi.fareHint: Estimate from the urban (red) taxi scale for this distance, with an allowance for traffic. Excludes tunnel tolls, luggage and pet surcharges, so the meter can legitimately read more.
taxi.inTaxi: I'm in the taxi — watch the route
taxi.inTaxiHint: uses GPS, keeps the screen awake
taxi.offRouteHint: This can be a normal diversion — roadworks or traffic. If you're unsure, ask the driver which way they're going.
clinic.title: Clinic & counters
clinic.hint: Say what's wrong, ask what happens next, and see where the wait is shortest.
clinic.dataNote: Hospital Authority data via HKGAI Toolhub. Headline figures are the median wait for less urgent cases — genuine emergencies are seen first. In an emergency call 999.
ride.demoBanner: Demo mode — the bus movement is simulated, your real location is not used.
ride.switchLive: Switch to Live GPS for a real ride
ride.gpsSearching: Searching for GPS… step near a window or outside.
